code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

# All values below were computed earlier in this job and are stored in
# provenance/TABLE_foldseek_segment_summary.csv, foldseek/plddt_by_domain.json
# and foldseek/foldseek_top10_pdb100_per_segment.csv

seg   = ["TSR1","CysRich","Spacer","CysRich+Spacer","TSR2-TSR4","TSR5-TSR9",
         "Ig1","ADAMTSL1_dom","Ig2-Ig4","TSR10-TSR13","PLAC"]
rng   = ["29-95","96-187","188-300","96-300","301-500","520-855","855-965",
         "1040-1120","1160-1490","1490-1730","1715-1762"]
evalue= [3.81e-4,5.13e-4,8.33e-4,1.18e-10,6.16e-4,1.94e-4,1.24e-6,5.01,
         1.38e-21,1.36e-3,2.10]
plddt = [75.8,84.3,83.8,84.1,65.0,75.5,84.4,71.5,80.8,77.6,58.2]
best  = ["TSP-1 TSR2-3\n1lsl_A","ADAMTS13 DTCS\n3ghm_A","ADAMTS13 DTCS\n3vn4_A",
         "ADAMTS13 DTCS\n3vn4_A","TSP-1\n1lsl_A","TSP-1\n1lsl_A","obscurin Ig\n2eo1_A",
         "none (noise)","DCC Ig1-4\n5z5k_A","complement C6 TSR\n3t5o_A","none (noise)"]
# Does any molecular function of the best homolog transfer to a secreted,
# protease-dead ADAMTSL1? Assessed per segment in this job.
transfer = ["no","no","no","no","no","no","no","n/a","no","no","n/a"]

x = -np.log10(np.array(evalue))
y = np.array(plddt)
col = ["#b03a2e" if t=="no" else "#999999" for t in transfer]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5,7))
ax.axvline(3, color="#777777", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.text(3.15, 55.5, "E = 1e-3\nconfidence threshold", fontsize=8, color="#555555")
ax.axhline(70, color="#777777", ls=":", lw=1)
ax.text(19.5, 70.6, "pLDDT 70", fontsize=8, color="#555555")
ax.scatter(x, y, s=190, c=col, edgecolor="black", zorder=3)

for xi, yi, s, r, b in zip(x, y, seg, rng, best):
    dy = 2.6 if s not in ("Spacer","CysRich+Spacer","TSR5-TSR9") else -5.2
    ax.annotate(f"{s} ({r})\n{b}", (xi, yi), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(0, dy*3.2), ha="center", fontsize=7.6)

ax.set_xlabel("structural-homology confidence,  -log10(best pdb100 E-value)")
ax.set_ylabel("mean AlphaFold pLDDT of the segment")
ax.set_xlim(-1.5, 23.5); ax.set_ylim(52, 92)
ax.set_title("ADAMTSL1 (Q8N6G6): 11 AlphaFold segments searched against pdb100 with Foldseek 3Di+AA.\n"
             "Nine segments have a confident structural homolog. In every case the homolog's molecular function\n"
             "comes from a domain ADAMTSL1 does not have, so no GO molecular function term transfers.",
             fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
h = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#b03a2e", edgecolor="black", label="confident fold assignment, no transferable molecular function"),
     mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#999999", edgecolor="black", label="no confident hit (E > 1), nothing to transfer")]
ax.legend(handles=h, loc="lower right", fontsize=8.5, frameon=True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("segments with E < 1e-3:", int((np.array(evalue) < 1e-3).sum()), "of 11")
print("segments with E < 1e-5:", int((np.array(evalue) < 1e-5).sum()), "of 11")
print("segments with mean pLDDT > 70:", int((y > 70).sum()), "of 11")
print("segments yielding a transferable MF term: 0 of 11")
